fields.label: Connection Preference
fields.help: The connection preference of service attachment.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Producer Accept Lists
fields.help: Projects that are allowed to connect to this network attachment.

fields.label: Producer Reject Lists
fields.help: Projects that are not allowed to connect to this network attachment.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: URL of the region where the network attachment resides.

fields.label: Subnetworks
fields.help: An array of URLs where each entry is the URL of a subnet provided by the service consumer to use for endpoints in the producers that connect to this network attachment.
